map.UPC-A 是北美零售商品的主流条码，共 12 位：第 1 位为数字系统字符（0: UPC-A is the mainstream barcode for retail products in North America, with 12 digits in total: the first is the number system character (0/1 for regular products, 2 for items sold by weight, 3 for drugs, 5 for coupons), followed by 5 digits of manufacturer code and 5 digits of product code, with the last digit as the check digit. It is compatible with EAN-13 — prefixing a UPC-A with 0 yields the equivalent EAN-13. Its encoding structure matches the right half of EAN-13: 7 modules per digit, 101 guard bars at each end, a 01010 separator in the middle, and a total width of 95 modules. The check digit weights odd positions ×3 and even positions ×1 from left to right, sums them, and takes the complement.

map.UPC-A 首位标识编号类别：0/1 为普通商品，2 为按重量计价的商品（生鲜、: The first digit of UPC-A identifies the numbering category: 0/1 for regular products, 2 for items sold by weight (fresh produce and meat — the trailing digits often encode price or weight), 3 for drugs (NDC), and 5 for coupons.
